meta.name: ai-amazon-storefront-design
meta.description: Amazon 店铺优化助手适合运营、产品、销售、software在用户提出“店铺首页能转化吗”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成商品/店铺诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议。

copy.tagline: 诊断亚马逊店铺首页并生成优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在运营亚马逊店铺，需要快速分析首页转化问题并获取可执行建议。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose Amazon storefront and generate optimization suggestions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成 Amazon 店铺优化助手。当你提供运营目标、目标买家、商品链接或资料时，它会分析并输出商品/店铺诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议。
howto.when: 当你提出“店铺首页能转化吗”这类问题，或需要围绕 Amazon 店铺生成诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议时触发。

say.text: 我的店铺首页转化率低，帮我诊断一下。
分析这个商品链接的卖点和风险。
针对目标买家是年轻妈妈，给出运营建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an Amazon storefront optimization assistant. When you provide business goals, target audience, product links or materials, it analyzes and outputs product/store diagnostics, selling points and risk alerts, and operational action suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions like 'Can my storefront convert?' or need diagnostics, selling points, risk alerts, and operational suggestions for an Amazon store.

say_en.text: My storefront conversion rate is low, help me diagnose it.
Analyze the selling points and risks of this product link.
Give operational suggestions for target audience of young mothers.
